control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at P-9504

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-9504 and M-9504 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-9504 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 28 September 2022 a planned assurance activity of P-9504 and M-9504 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop found the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment not effective.
